description: Open Source Platform for DTC, B2B Commerce, Marketplaces & Omnichannel. REST APIs, TypeScript SDKs, and production-ready Next.js storefront. Self-host it. Own your data. No vendor lock-in. Zero platform fees.
vibe: Deterministic task runners, disciplined formatting, and modular consistency.
highlights: Area rules live next to the code and load when you work there: `spree/AGENTS.md` (Ruby gems, APIs, RSpec), `packages/AGENTS.md` (TypeScript packages, dashboards, Playwright) and `docs/AGENTS.md` (documentation site). Anything not covered follows standard Ruby on Rails 8.1 and React / TanStack / Vite practice — these files only record what this codebase does differently or what has bitten us before.

Feature plans live in `docs/plans/`, written from `docs/plans/_template.md` — never anywhere else. Before a significant architectural change, check existing plans for conflicts, including their "Constraints on Current Work" sections, which apply even when you aren't implementing that plan. Use `/create-plan`, `/update-plan`, and `/implement-plan <plan>` to deliver one end to end.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
